gap_text: No measured comparison exists between the winners and any alternative scanner or SBOM tool. The winners rest on native execution only.
next_check: On the same Nautilus runtime venv, compare package counts and matches from syft against trivy (or cdxgen) and from grype against osv-scanner (or pip-audit).
